summary: Both editions were independently checked against all seven paragraphs of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was found. Both preserve the commands, necessity, conditional inspection, negations, speaker assignments, solemn appeal by the Lord, and comparative description of the virgins. The bracketed first “everything” is disclosed as an editorial insertion rather than preserved unbracketed text. The notes retain the working readings and explicitly leave the unidentified Athos alternative unresolved. Acceptance is limited to fidelity and disclosure against the supplied material: apparatus statements are treated as reported claims, not independently authenticated manuscript readings or an exhaustive collation.
